queries: SELECT t."ordertypedist" AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS matched_record_count FROM "advancedbehavior" AS a INNER JOIN "transactionrecord" AS t ON t."transreg" = a."translink" WHERE a."patsim" > 0.439 GROUP BY t."ordertypedist" ORDER BY t."ordertypedist" NULLS FIRST;

SELECT t."ordertypedist", COUNT(*) AS matched_records
FROM "advancedbehavior" AS a
JOIN "transactionrecord" AS t ON t."transreg" = a."translink"
WHERE a."patsim" > 0.439
GROUP BY t."ordertypedist";

SELECT tr."ordertypedist", COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM "advancedbehavior" AS ab JOIN "transactionrecord" AS tr ON tr."transreg" = ab."translink" WHERE ab."patsim" > 0.439 GROUP BY tr."ordertypedist"
